compiler.stage: Stage 0 (the TypeScript compiler run by bun); no native compiler build was used

build: bun run z build z/tools/zjsz --release, against an isolated clone of the compiler at the revision above
note: Each stage is the engine at one commit. A stage differs from the one before it by that commit only, so a column of the matrix is the incremental effect of its change on top of all the earlier ones, in this order. It is not what the change would do alone or in another order.

stages.name: base
stages.change: The previous checkpoint's engine (97d9e1b) plus the measurement flags; the engine's behaviour is unchanged.

stages.name: atoms
stages.change: The names the engine looks up constantly are atoms it holds.

stages.name: calls
stages.change: Engine calls with up to two arguments write them into registers.

stages.name: arenas
stages.change: A sweep sizes its arena once; small heaps flip between two kept arenas.

stages.name: promise
stages.change: A promise is two cells, a reaction one, a job none.

stages.name: suspend
stages.change: Async bodies hand their driver a value; a suspension reuses its register array.

stages.name: plain
stages.change: Awaiting a non-object value queues its continuation directly.

stages.name: ints
stages.change: An int32 becomes a string in one allocation.

stages.name: table
stages.change: The handle table has an extent a sweep can cut back.

stages.name: queue
stages.change: The job queue reuses its own storage.

stages.name: report
stages.change: The storage report (--mem-stats); the heap reads its arrays' capacity where it had estimated it. No engine behaviour changes.

native_backend: z/build/native is built once by z/native.sh from z/engine/native at the tree's revision and reused as is for every stage; each build records its digests and the revision that last touched its sources.
